description: Set automatically when an exception is raised while another is being handled; printed as "During handling of the above exception".
Set by `raise new from original`; printed as "The above exception was the direct cause".
Sets `__suppress_context__` so the traceback hides the context; the original stays in `__context__`.
Since 3.11, strings attached to an exception after it was created and printed after its message.
Re-raises the exception being handled, unchanged, from inside an `except` block.
